verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Conductor is a GUI (Mac app) with a programmatic API and hosted MCP server, but there is no mention anywhere of an official Conductor CLI tool; the only CLI reference is to using local GitHub CLI auth for GitHub sign-in, which is unrelated. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability (a CLI would be plausible for a dev tool with an API) means this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
